caveat: All 82 manually mapped to source-specific formulas and existing catalog names. ALGEBRAIC_DUPLICATE validated against native at same period on 480 synthetic bars, with <=1e-8 residual. EXISTING_FAMILY and ADDITIONAL_OUTPUT are formula-semantic classifications, not a proof of exact numeric equality. UNREPRESENTED means no named same-formula scalar in 435 names; not a proof of globally new mathematics. Differences can come from lookback, seeds, ddof and plotting. No registry changes.
